'''July 2001 EPP Overdrive tournament (18 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 18 July 2001. [[Michael Pistone]] won it. It is known from Jon Bragg's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2666">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-19-mr-wow-goes-to-epp-overdrive-7-18-01d2666/ mr-wow-goes-to-epp-overdrive-7-18-01], DeckTech (Jon "Wow" Bragg, 19 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-19-mr-wow-goes-to-epp-overdrive-7-18-01d2666/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 July 2001
* '''Format:''' [[EPP Overdrive]]
* '''Players:''' 6
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Pistone]]
